# What does your doula package really pay per hour?

> Free calculator for birth doulas: your real pay per hour after long labors, driving, on-call days, backup cover and overhead, and the package price that reaches your target. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
